biggest_catch: Upside's official page publishes no exact payout timing and no fee schedule for restaurant/grocery cashback — the mechanism (claim offer, purchase, cashback to your account, cash out to bank or gift cards with no minimum) is official, but the timing/fees are unstated.
catches: No official payout timing is published — third-party reports of up to 10 business days and a $1 fee under $15 are not official Upside pages and are not cited here.
Cashback rates are personalized per offer ('average 8% grocery/dining, up to 45% restaurant, up to 30% grocery' per the official Play listing) — your actual rate depends on the offer you claim.
The official business FAQ confirms transaction-level data use: Upside personalizes offers from your purchase data — a privacy/data trade-off.
This route covers restaurant/grocery cashback only, not Upside's referral program — assessed per the route scope.

steps: Download the free Upside app from the official listing (com.upside.consumer.android) or App Store.
Browse and claim a nearby restaurant or grocery cashback offer in the app.
Pay for your purchase and complete any purchase instructions shown in the offer.
Cashback is added to your Upside account after the purchase.
Cash out directly to your bank account or to gift cards from your favorite retailers — 'No minimum amount required.'
timing: Not published on official pages — cash out in-app once the cashback is in your account; no minimum required.
